newsitem.title: POLAND: POLIFARBS, SURGE ON MERGER PLAN.
newsitem.headline: POLIFARBS, SURGE ON MERGER PLAN.

text.p: Polish paintmakers Polifarb Cieszyn and Polifarb Wroclaw surged 9.7 and 9.4 percent to 15.9 and 15.1 zlotys respectively on Friday after the firms announced they planned to merge, traders said.
"The near maximum growth shows investors think the merger will help both firms, as together they will have about 50 percent of the paint market," one trader said.

Strong buying after price fixing of Cieszyn meant investors had their bids reduced then while Wroclaw did not trade after price fixing due to excess demand. One trader said the stocks could surge to 18 or 19 zlotys.-Warsaw Newsroom+48 22 653 9700
